work.name: OpkodeLabs
work.summary: Developed WattLink, a full-stack multi-tenant EV charging station management platform, built on the OCPP 1.6 protocol. highlights: OCPP 1.6, Laravel, Python, Redis, Docker, Socket.IO, Grafana
